policy: Individual angels are represented by investor records and are not duplicated as their own team members.
Only publicly verified, investment-relevant leaders are imported.
Strategic corporate executives are not imported unless their role is tied to the investment activity.
A missing member record is documented as a coverage gap and never treated as proof that no team exists.
Personal LinkedIn URLs remain null unless uniquely verified.
